profile.headline: Web Developer at CSC
profile.summary:
Front End Web Developer with proven experience building and designing dynamic websites, projects and applications. 

DEVELOPER SKILLS:
HTML
CSS
JavaScript
React
Responsive Web Design
Flexbox
APIs
Git/GitHub

Due to the uncertainty surrounding the Covid pandemic, I took the initiative to grow my skillset and pursue a career in coding. What started as an interest quickly became a passion, and I can confidently say I look forward to what the future holds for my career in tech.
